Commissary stock paid back: {refund}. Open orders are cancelled, they were not paid yet, and standing orders end.
foodtrucks:dialog_commissary_nothing: Sorry, we have nothing to deliver right now.
foodtrucks:notification_commissary_order: Add at least one box or piece to the order.
One order takes at most {max} boxes and pieces.
foodtrucks:dialog_commissary_quote:
So that's:
{items}
{goods} plus {fee} delivery, {total} in all, paid on delivery here at {time} tomorrow. The fee is per delivery here: one fee for everything we bring that morning, shared with any other order arriving then. Shall we book it?
foodtrucks:dialog_commissary_quote_share:
So that's:
{items}
{goods}, paid on delivery here at {time} tomorrow. No extra delivery fee: another order already comes here that morning, and the {perDelivery} fee is per delivery here, not per order. Shall we book it?
foodtrucks:commissary_form_item_left: {item}, box of {box} · {stock} here · {left} left this week
foodtrucks:commissary_over_limit: Phone orders are limited to {limit} boxes of each food a week for your whole fleet, at all commissaries together. {left} more boxes of {item} are left in the week from day {day}, and this order needs {needed}. Take fewer boxes, or stock a warehouse and send it here with a logistics plan.
foodtrucks:dialog_commissary_how_often: Just this once, or should we repeat it?
foodtrucks:dialog_commissary_repeat_whic: Every day, or every week on {weekday}? Each delivery is paid when it arrives, at that day's prices.
foodtrucks:message_commissary_standing_p: Standing order: {items}, {repeat} at {time} from day {day}, paid on each delivery at that day's prices, plus the {fee} delivery fee, once per morning we deliver here (shared with other orders arriving then). Call us to cancel it.
foodtrucks:dialog_commissary_start_nospa: {commissary}. You have no space here, so we can't take new orders, but you still have {standing} standing orders with us.
foodtrucks:dialog_commissary_standing_no: No standing orders left at {commissary}. Rent a space at our bay to order again.
foodtrucks:dialog_commissary_standing_on: Standing order {index} of {count}: {items}, {repeat}. Next delivery {weekday} (day {day}) at {time}.
foodtrucks:dialog_commissary_standing_do: That's all: {count} standing orders. Anything else?
foodtrucks:message_commissary_standing_u: We couldn't deliver {units} {item} from your standing order: the payment of {total} didn't go through. Only today's delivery is cancelled; the standing order stays.
foodtrucks:message_commissary_standing_c: This week's limit on phone orders, one for your whole fleet, cut today's standing order: {cut}. The rest is on its way; the limit starts again on {weekday}, and the standing order stays.
foodtrucks:message_commissary_standing_n: We can't get {items} any more, so it's left out of your standing order.
No vehicle has a space here any more, so your standing order ({items}) wasn't delivered today. It stays on our list; call us to cancel it.
foodtrucks:message_commissary_crew_short: Your crew loaded the {vehicle} here ({loaded}), but we had no {items} for it. Order more, or bring it here yourself.
foodtrucks:todo_missing_crew: Not enough crew for its route
foodtrucks:todo_no_equipment: No cooking equipment: its crew is paid but can't sell. Fit a machine at its commissary
foodtrucks:route_cause_times: it can't run, check the stops' times
foodtrucks:route_cause_overlap: it can't run, two stops' times overlap
foodtrucks:route_cause_unreachable: stop {number} on {day} opens before the {way} there can end
foodtrucks:route_cause_before_shift_driv: {cause}: the restock and drive start before the shift
foodtrucks:route_cause_before_shift_walk: {cause}: the restock and walk start before the shift
foodtrucks:todo_no_permit: No vending permit: buy one from the City
foodtrucks:todo_no_commissary_space: No commissary space: fined at 04:00 unless at your property or still working. The pin leads to the nearest commissary
foodtrucks:todo_health_grade_c: Health grade C: clean it at its commissary
foodtrucks:todo_licence_running_out: Vendor licence runs out after day {day}: renew it with the City
foodtrucks:todo_licence_expired: Vendor licence has run out: renew it with the City
foodtrucks:notification_todo_no_place: This vehicle is with your private driver, so it has no place on the map.
foodtrucks:notification_todo_on_the_way: This vehicle is on its way to its next stop. Set the destination once it has arrived.
foodtrucks:bizman_page_menu_empty: No food on board, and none sold on its last days out.
foodtrucks:bizman_cooler_slot: Dedicated drinks fridge — leaves the general equipment places free
foodtrucks:bizman_page_route_no_crew: No crew: the route doesn't run until someone is assigned.
foodtrucks:bizman_page_route_short_crew: Short of crew: {count} of {limit}. It runs short-handed.
foodtrucks:bizman_page_route_no_permit: No vending permit: it can't open at its stops. Buy one from the City.
foodtrucks:route_moved_drive: Stop {number} now opens at {open} ({minutes} min drive from stop {from})
foodtrucks:route_moved_walk: Stop {number} now opens at {open} ({minutes} min walk from stop {from})
foodtrucks:notification_route_travel_stu: Stop {number} opens before the crew can get there from stop {from}, and there's no later time left for it. Change its hours or the stops before it.
foodtrucks:bizman_page_route_invalid_tra: A stop opens before the crew can get there from the one before, so it opens late. Give it a later opening.
foodtrucks:bizman_page_route_no_space: No commissary space: the day starts and ends where the vehicle stands.
foodtrucks:bizman_page_route_back_late: Back after the {time} check, so it isn't in the bay for it.
foodtrucks:bizman_page_route_ends_in_bay: Ends at its last stop, in the {commissary} bay
foodtrucks:bizman_fleet_where_home: On the way back to its commissary
foodtrucks:bizman_week_auto_week_confirm: Replace this vehicle's shifts for the whole week with the auto schedule?
foodtrucks:bizman_week_hours_wanted: {hours} of {min}–{max} h a week, {wage} an hour, {satisfaction}%
foodtrucks:bizman_week_gap_restock: Nobody on shift {from}–{to}: no restock, it waits in the bay.
foodtrucks:bizman_week_gap_drive: Nobody on shift {from}–{to}: it waits closed before the drive to stop {number}.
foodtrucks:bizman_week_gap_stop: Nobody on shift {from}–{to}: stop {number} stays closed.
foodtrucks:bizman_week_gap_back: Nobody on shift {from}–{to}: it waits at its last stop before the drive back.
foodtrucks:bizman_page_route_uncovered: Part of a route day has nobody on shift: the vehicle waits closed there until a shift starts.
foodtrucks:notification_shift_too_long: A shift is at most {max} hours.
foodtrucks:notification_schedule_hours_r: The opening hours follow the vehicle's route.
foodtrucks:dialog_event_location: The event is outside {place}. Set a GPS destination, or find the building on the city map under Street food > Premium spots and events. Park nearby, within {metres} metres of an entrance.
foodtrucks:message_bookings_location_can: Your {kind} booking on {weekday} (day {day}) at {start} was cancelled because its address is no longer available. Your booking reputation has not been reduced.
